HULING ARAW NG TRANSPORT STRIKE

Transport group Manibela ended its three-day transport strike by marching from Mabuhay Rotonda to Mendiola in Manila, where it held a program on Friday, April 17.

The protest caused traffic congestion along España.

📸 The STAR/Edd Gumban https://t.co/Uyt4rt45Ph

data.text:
IN PHOTOS: Members of the transport group Manibela marched from Welcome Rotonda to Mendiola in Manila on Friday, April 17, 2026, to mark the end of their three-day transport strike. The group renewed calls for the repeal of the Oil Deregulation Law and the suspension of value-added and excise taxes on petroleum products. 

📸: Norman Cruz
